summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a routine update to its at-the-market offering program and bitcoin holdings. For September 28-30, 2026, no shares of STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD or MSTR stock were sold. For October 1-4, 2026, the company sold 92,894 MSTR Class A shares for $15.7 million in net proceeds, applied to bitcoin purchases. Remaining availability totals roughly $44.1 billion across all securities. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed; this is an ordinary capital-markets and treasury update.
